notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited after saving, but collected metadata cannot be reviewed or edited before save.
REF-BM-04: Supports title, description, note, and tag additions, but cannot edit the URL, remove tags, or clear a note.
REF-BM-05: No bookmark deletion endpoint or UI.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags, but use generated domain initials instead of favicons.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and note but omits URL.
REF-BM-14: No #tag search syntax.
REF-BM-15: No boolean operators or parenthesised query parsing.
REF-BM-16: No exact quoted-phrase search semantics.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results are hard-coded to creation-date order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and viewed, but are escaped and displayed as plain text rather than rendered Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF-download support.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or archive action.
REF-BM-27: Archive versus permanent delete is not implemented.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: No saved filter bundles.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings.
